gbm_population_evidence.quote: (example: GBM or sarcoma with local relapse after surgery, chemo-radiation)

gbm_population_flag.reason: GBM is named in the inclusion criteria only as an example of an eligible localized disease, not as a cohort or condition.

candidate_evidence.quote: MVX-ONCO-2 is a patient-specific, cell-based, active immunotherapy where the participant's immune response to their own tumor cells is stimulated and/or increased.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: documented tumor progression after at least one line of systemic therapy and for which no further standard therapies are available, feasible or accepted by the patient

role_evidence.quote: MVX-ONCO-2 is composed of a cell suspension of irradiated autologous tumor cells and two capsules loaded with allogenic genetically modified cells releasing an immunomodulator, granulocyte-macrophage colony stimulating factor (GM-CSF).

agents.drug_class_hint: autologous irradiated tumour cell vaccine with encapsulated GM-CSF-secreting allogeneic cells
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: the participant's immune response to their own tumor cells is stimulated and/or increased

coder_notes: Solid-tumour basket; GBM is named only in an eligibility example (local relapse after surgery and chemo-radiation). The sole intervention is a cell-based cancer vaccine, an excluded intervention type, so no candidate. GM-CSF is a component of the vaccine cells, not a separate intervention.
